distributorConfirmation.basis: Explicit affirmative user reply confirming lawful use of the installed Community 2026 and agreement to proceed under its section 8 distribution conditions.
distributorConfirmation.responsibility: Distributor accepts responsibility for the applicable conditions, including application-related indemnity/defense/hold-harmless with the exception for claims based solely on Distributable Code.
distributorConfirmation.scope: User declaration, not an agent's acceptance on the user's behalf, independent legal audit or general legal clearance; no repeat request for the same distributor decision is needed.

externalDistributorAndEndUserAgreement.scope: Microsoft DLLs and downstream distribution only; not restrictions on the AGPL application or a requirement for end users to install/license Visual Studio.

endUserAcceptancePlan.termsScope: Shared offline terms limited to shipped Microsoft MSVC DLLs, not restrictions on the AGPL plugin or other open-source code.
endUserAcceptancePlan.promptTrigger: First active action needing the backend, or explicit click in settings; no repeated prompts from background monitoring/cleanup.
endUserAcceptancePlan.persistence: Acceptance persists for the same terms identity, independently of plugin version changes.
endUserAcceptancePlan.declineEffect: Disable only the backend; ordinary Zotero use and reading already saved PDFs remain available.
endUserAcceptancePlan.installationImpact: Consent adds no installation steps: no Visual Studio, Microsoft account, purchased license or separate redistributable installer; existing backend setup requirements are unchanged.
endUserAcceptancePlan.deliveryFollowUp: All four private packages are rebuilt and locally verified; Windows consent and Linux exemption are natively verified. Retained original VS/Runtime documents and DLL bytes are unchanged. Hash-bound source delivery is recorded separately in candidate-delivery-0.3.6.json; no public assets or feeds are changed.
